echo "Creating python3 alias for the system python..."
echo "alias python3='/usr/local/bin/python3.13'" >> /root/.bashrc

echo "=== Final comprehensive test ==="
/usr/local/bin/python3.13 -c "
import numpy as np
import cv2
import pymagsac

# Test basic imports
print('✓ All imports successful')
print('Python executable:', import sys; sys.executable)
print('OpenCV version:', cv2.__version__)
print('Numpy version:', np.__version__)

# Test OpenCV functionality
print('✓ OpenCV has SIFT:', hasattr(cv2, 'xfeatures2d') and hasattr(cv2.xfeatures2d, 'SIFT_create'))

# Test a simple SIFT operation
try:
    sift = cv2.xfeatures2d.SIFT_create()
    print('✓ SIFT_create works')
except Exception as e:
    print('✗ SIFT_create failed:', e)

# Test pymagsac basic functionality
print('✓ pymagsac location:', pymagsac.__file__)

print('\n=== Installation Summary ===')
print('✓ OpenCV: Available with SIFT support')
print('✓ pymagsac: Installed from local directory /app/magsac')
print('✓ All requirements met!')
"
